tools.name: charge_retainer_to_matter
tools.description: Charges a client's saved card for a retainer deposit and records the payment on the matter's trust ledger in the database.

params.name: matter_id
params.description: Matter identifier the retainer is for

params.name: customer_id
params.description: Stripe customer ID of the client

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import stripe
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("legal-billing")
DB_PATH = "firm.db"


@mcp.tool()
def charge_retainer_to_matter(matter_id: str, amount_cents: int, customer_id: str) -> dict:
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=amount_cents,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        confirm=True,
        off_session=True,
        metadata={"matter_id": matter_id},
    )
    with sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) as conn:
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO trust_ledger (matter_id, amount_cents, payment_ref, kind) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'retainer')",
            (matter_id, amount_cents, intent.id),
        )
    return {"payment_id": intent.id, "status": intent.status}

tools.name: run_contract_review_job_and_grant_access
tools.description: Runs the contract review script on a document and then gives the named reviewer edit access to the document.

params.name: reviewer_email
params.description: Email of the reviewer who is granted edit access

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import subprocess
from agents import function_tool


@function_tool
def run_contract_review_job_and_grant_access(document_id: str, reviewer_email: str) -> str:
    review_script_completed_process = subprocess.run(
        ["python", "scripts/review_contract.py", "--doc", document_id],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        check=True,
    )
    with sqlite3.connect("firm.db") as database_connection:
        database_connection.execute(
            "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO document_permissions (document_id, user_email, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'editor')",
            (document_id, reviewer_email),
        )
    return review_script_completed_process.stdout[-500:]

tools.name: archive_expired_drafts
tools.description: Moves draft documents for a matter that are older than the cutoff date into the archive folder and permanently deletes any empty draft folders left behind.

params.name: matter_dir
params.description: Path to the matter's drafts directory

params.name: cutoff_date
params.description: ISO date; drafts last modified before this are moved

tools.code:
import shutil
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from langchain_core.tools import tool


@tool
def archive_expired_drafts(matter_dir: str, cutoff_date: str, archive_dir: str) -> str:
    src = Path(matter_dir)
    dst = Path(archive_dir)
    dst.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    cut = datetime.fromisoformat(cutoff_date).timestamp()
    moved = 0
    for f in src.rglob("*"):
        if f.is_file() and f.stat().st_mtime < cut:
            rel = f.relative_to(src)
            target = dst / rel
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.move(str(f), str(target))
            moved += 1
    gone = 0
    for d in sorted(src.rglob("*"), reverse=True):
        if d.is_dir() and not any(d.iterdir()):
            d.rmdir()
            gone += 1
    return f"Moved {moved} drafts, removed {gone} empty folders"
